summary: Native Rust / Bevy reconstruction now routes world controls through the original event rules, decodes all embedded bank sounds, and includes tetherball serve/motion arithmetic. Complete minigame gameplay remains unfinished.

metrics.label: Control tables
metrics.detail: Bindings across all 14 original CSV files

metrics.label: Embedded audio
metrics.detail: Bank sounds decoded, including all 12 MPEG-2 sounds

details: Controller button edges, tap/hold/double/repeat timers, modifiers and context transitions drive the Bevy keyboard adapter from controls.csv.
MPEG Layer 3: 1,536 LSF mappings, 72 spectral scaling vectors and 48 reorder vectors compared with original PowerPC. Full console PCM equality remains unverified.
Tetherball arithmetic covers serve/toss timing, radius/velocity changes, zones and score calculation. Ball Update/Hit, AI and complete game states remain to be ported.
Existing frame/physics timing (412 cases) and tournament scoring (210 transitions) remain covered. Native ports do not promote entire surrounding functions to proven status.
scope: Native reconstruction evidence is tracked separately from the whole-function decompilation and lifter percentages below.
